title: Load Sentinel-2 Level-1C RGB+NIR imagery with QA60 cloud filtering
description: Use Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI imagery (S2A+S2B) and the Level-1C product from Google Earth Engine (COPERNICUS/S2). Use RGB and NIR bands. Exclude scenes with more than 20% cloud coverage using the QA60 band cloud mask. This optical data is used for multimodal infrastructure classification (paired with Sentinel-1 SAR composites).
